project_type: Next.js 16 full-stack app with Drizzle ORM + Neon DB (PostgreSQL)
verification_instructions: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm 0 errors. The project has no test suite beyond type checking.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. DB is remote Neon PostgreSQL. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript must pass with 0 errors via `npx tsc --noEmit`
key_patterns: Single scheduler engine in src/lib/scheduler/engine.ts exports ejecutarScheduler(). API route at src/app/api/scheduler/run/route.ts imports and calls it. UI at src/app/dashboard/scheduler/page.tsx is a client component that posts config+gestion to the API. Results displayed from DB at src/app/dashboard/resultados/. DB schema uses Drizzle ORM with pgTable. ejecuciones table tracks runs with activa boolean and gestion field. Config stored as JSONB.
directory_structure: src/lib/scheduler/ - scheduler engine; src/types/ - shared types; src/app/api/scheduler/run/ - API route; src/app/dashboard/scheduler/ - execution UI; src/app/dashboard/resultados/ - results viewing; src/db/ - Drizzle schema and DB connection
